newsitem.title: USA: NHL ICE HOCKEY-WHALERS CENTER PRIMEAU SUSPENDED FOR SLASHING.
newsitem.headline: NHL ICE HOCKEY-WHALERS CENTER PRIMEAU SUSPENDED FOR SLASHING.

text.p: The National Hockey League suspended Hartford Whalers centre Keith Primeau Thursday for at least one game for a slashing incident against Washington Capitals centre Joe Juneau in a New Year's Day contest.
Primeau will miss at least Thursday night's game against the Boston Bruins before a hearing on Friday is held to determine the full suspension.
Juneau hit Primeau behind the net and was skating away when Primeau launched a heavy slash that gave Juneau a severe bruise on the left shoulder. Juneau is expected to miss two weeks with the injury.
Primeau was assessed a major penalty for slashing and given a game misconduct by referee Lance Roberts.
